title: 菲奥娜·玫瑰小瓶
description: 短发菲奥娜穿端正蓝白长装，整理一枝玫瑰，细剑保持入鞘。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Fiora is an adult Demacian duelist with a precise dark bob, a striking pink-red hair streak, pale eyes, and an aristocratic composed face. Preserve her fitted blue-white tailoring and shoulder armor through a fully covering jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and tall boots. Her elegant slender rapier stays safely sheathed at her side, with the ornate guard visible and no fencing stance.
art_direction.scene: She stands beside a narrow table and turns a single rose in a little glass vase until the blossom faces the window. Her free hand rests lightly on the tabletop instead of her sword. One plain curtain and a round upholstered stool suggest a quiet sitting room, with a small pleased smile softening her formal bearing.
art_direction.palette: royal blue, ivory, rose pink, cool gray
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
